title: Selecting a template highlights that row with a checkmark
custom_steps:
1. Click the Service Manager template.
  2. Look at that row.
  3. Look at the other rows.
custom_expected:
The Service Manager row is highlighted with a checkmark.

The other rows stay in their normal state.

Only one template can be chosen at a time.
evidence: UI: selecting the Foreman template highlights that card (choose-template-card selected) and shows a checkmark (hasCheck true). screenshot template-selected.
